source: ECMA-376 Part1 fifth edition2016, normative SpreadsheetML styles component
code_source: Independent Jade implementation; no ibis/Apache implementation code incorporated
style_references_in_normative_data: Pivot definitions use zero-based dxf indices (0..N-1). The ordinary table definitions in the same unmodified file use one-based indices and are not loaded by this pivot renderer.

normative_sample.purpose: Legacy explicitly formatted reports must not receive a style merely from defaultPivotStyle.
